title: Voidkat Corner Modpack
description: Modpack for playing on the VKC minecraft server.
body:
This modpack is made specifically for the Minecraft server availiable via the [VOIDKAT CORNER](https://discord.gg/yqHnKkAhc7) Discord server, but can be used for any other purpose.

It is a Fabric modpack that attempts to make an optimized client-side experience for the [Create Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) mod. It includes Create itself, some add-ons, and some miscellaneous mods for fun and quality of life.

You should probably only use this modpack specifically for playing on the VKC server, but I don't make the rules! Modify it to your liking, enjoy!
